articles.title: A New Era of Multi-Sport Storytelling: ANOC and Spectatr.ai at the Islamic Solidarity Games Riyadh 2025
articles.mainIdea: A New Era of Multi-Sport Storytelling: ANOC and Spectatr.ai at the Islamic Solidarity Games Riyadh 2025
articles.summary: PR Newswire: A New Era of Multi-Sport Storytelling: ANOC and Spectatr.ai at the Islamic Solidarity Games Riyadh 2025. The 6th Islamic Solidarity Games (ISG) Riyadh 2025 marked a significant step forward in multi-sport digital coverage. The Association of National Olympic Committees (ANOC), in collaboration with the Islamic Solidarity Sports Association (ISSA), partnered with AI sports technology company Spectatr.ai to deliver real-time, AI-powered highlights at scale, reshaping how large sporting events are captured and shared with global audiences.
